summary_1line: Yudhishthira prepares and begins the Rajasuya sacrifice, appoints priests, gathers materials, invites all kingdoms, and hosts vast assemblies including the Kauravas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira enters the vast sacrificial compound surrounded by thousands of Brahmanas, his brothers, and gathered kings from many lands.
Craftsmen build fragrant halls and pavilions like divine temples within the enormous Rajasuya sacrificial enclosure.
Rows of Brahmanas feast and converse while gifts of cows, gold, beds, and garments are distributed throughout the bustling camp.
